answer_risk_cost_target.characters_interpretation: deterministic context-volume proxy only; not measured tokens, latency, memory, or cost

legally_recoverable_evidence.method: Exact or semantically equivalent operand recovery plus visible scale/precision rules; paragraph relevance alone is not treated as semantic necessity.
